meta.description: Every control the Element Assembly Studio Pro dialog shows, per system. Generated: do not edit by hand.
meta.note: Values stored on an element hold more keys than these controls (removal lists, per-casement overrides, edge colour ids): the defaults and presets carry them.

window_family.dialog_defaults_note: Every control default, children included (MainUiLogic na_init). The dialog then merges the Ruby defaults (WindowSystem Defaults NA_DEFAULT_CONFIG) over these: the seam does the same.

patterns.note: Per Casement Settings: not flat keys. The window stores them in config.casement_overrides, keyed by casement "o:c:p".
